title: Strict-complex Roos functor
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with countable products [def-weil-category-product]. For a strict tower $C:\mathbf N^{op}\to\operatorname{CochainComplex}(\mathcal A,\mathbf Z)$ [def-weil-inverse-system], set $s_C$ to be its product shift and $b_C=1-s_C$ [def-weil-tower-transition-endomorphism]. Define $\operatorname{Roos}(C)=\operatorname{Cone}(b_C)[-1]$, using the signed cochain mapping cocone [def-weil-signed-mapping-cocone-functor]. Define the functor on strict towers by sending a natural transformation $a:C\to C'$ to the mapping-cocone map whose two coordinates are $\prod_n a_n$. This is the strict-complex model of [def-weil-derived-limit], with actual chosen product projections and cone coordinates.
